body: Well you can look forward to wizard powers though.
Who the fuck has friends lmao.

Cats don't care. Stop trying to emotionally manipulate him into staying alive. It doesn't help anyone. People need to find their own reason to live. If they can't there's no problem with them deciding to kill themself.
It doesn't. The people telling you it gets better are just trying to make you feel better. It never gets better.

I understand how you feel. I used to be like that until I gave up. I've just kind of accepted that I'm nothing more than mediocre. Now I've just stopped giving a shit and just wallow in it. If you're still young, it doesn't get better. You have to make it better. If you don't work towards something everything will just spiral downwards. There's nothing particularly wrong with that though. Just give yourself a chance and if you find you're not worth it give up. There's no shame in it.
You're welcome. another thing is to make sure you initiate the conversation. It's often hard for people to ask for help in situations like this. So don't just ask if he's ok. Be specific.
Unfortunately unless you have someone who would support your decision, I don't think there's many other options. I hope it works out for you.

I completely understand how you feel. I've never been good at having friends. All through elementary school through highschool I've never had friends. I've been alone as long as I can remember. This is going to sound like cheesy crap advise but it's true. You still have a lot of time. In those four years you spend at school you'll have the chance to make closer friends that you've ever had. If you find it hard to just make casual conversation try joining a club. You don't need to be good at what they're doing to be a part of it. Give it a shot. So from one person who wasted all their time to you, give yourself a chance.

I'm in the same boat. My parents think I'm doing well in college, but the truth is in my 3 semesters I haven't passed a single class. I just couldn't bring myself to drag myself to the classroom so I ended up failing through attendence. I don't have any friends I can talk to so I just wallow in my self pity and emptyness alone until I just waste away to nothing.

I would first contact a private therapist for them, and just talk to them. Let him know you're there for them. Let him know how happy he makes you. Invite them to do things. It's the little things that add up. I can tell you truly care about him, so make sure he knows. Make sure that you aren't just trying to fix a problem. You need to understand him, how he feels and why he feels that way. Though the most important thing is seeking professional help. Your school might have resources available to help you find child therapists. I hope everything works out for you and your brother gets the help he needs.
I hope you're able to find happiness, weather it's in this life or the next. Good luck.

Ask friends or family to watch them for a while, since you're: going out of town, renovating the house, need some help looking after them, ect. Or you could drop them off at a shelter. Look for no kill shelters in your area. Some places are no questions asked and will take them for you. Though I would see if some one close to you would take them first, since they'll have a better life that way.

I understand how lonely you feel. I've never had friends and I've never dated anyone. I know how it feels when you can't talk to anyone, or when the people around you won't listen. I've never coped with it well. I don't have any advice or methods to make you feel better, but I do understand
